title: Podcaster
summary: For podcasts and their hosts: follow buttons first, the latest episodes, everywhere to listen, and a way for guests and sponsors to reach you.

cards.purpose: The main ask: follow the show.
The three to six latest or best episodes.
Every platform the show is on.
How guests and sponsors get in touch.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: Where should people follow the show first? Share the show's links and its RSS feed if public.
slots.write: Heading = the schedule; first button = the platform they prefer (subscribe preset).

slots.ask: Which three to six episodes should a new listener hear?
slots.write: tag = episode number · length; title exactly as published; description = the guest and their role, as credited.

slots.ask: Which platforms is the show on? Paste the show pages.
Do you take guest pitches or sponsors? Which address may be public?
slots.write: Text = what a good pitch looks like and how sponsorship works, in their words. Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it.

slots.ask: Anything listeners should know about you or how the show is made?
slots.write: Two or three sentences, including how the show is funded if they say.
